en: Black‑and‑white outdoor scene showing a group of men in suits and hats relaxing on deck chairs in a sandy courtyard or garden. Two large leafless trees dominate the foreground, with traditional plastered buildings and a tiled roof behind them. In the background are wooded hills and more rural structures, giving the impression of a spa, sanatorium, or pension in a Central European village. A handwritten number or note appears along the right edge.
